Name: Custom Companions
Author: PeacefulEnd
Description:
See the GitHub repository for an [url=https://github.com/Floogen/CustomCompanions/wiki]in-depth wiki[/url] on how to create a content pack for Custom Companions.

See the example pack in the [b]Optional Files [/b]section for example companions.

[b]Multiplayer is supported!
[/b]
[b][url=https://github.com/Floogen/CustomCompanions/wiki/Content-Patcher-Integration]Content Patcher[/url] is supported!

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8386]Save Anywhere[/url] is supported![/b]

Source code is [url=https://github.com/Floogen/CustomCompanions/tree/main]available here[/url].

Downloads.Description:
Requires Json Assets, due to it adding rings via Objects folder.

Adds a few summoning rings to the Hat Mouse's shop.
